summary: Signalled intersection on a main road; No Stopping and nowhere to pull off.

drivers.seclusion: Busy junction with commercial buildings 9 m away and shops opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is the corner of a junction with crossings and turn lanes; no room to stop out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Heavy arterial traffic with traffic lights.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time sign 1 m from the line; no cars park here.
